title: Reading Drill — Preserving a timber floor — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Preserving a timber floor — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The building conservator in Brackenton received an old report about floorboards wearing faster near one doorway. The report compared the depth of the wear marks, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the profile measurements rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered eight weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include past floor treatments. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a removable entrance mat as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
